# CLAUDE.md

This file provides guidance to Claude Code (claude.ai/code) when working with code in this repository.

## Repo ownership (agreed 2026-08-08)

**This repo is the one you work in.** Two sibling efforts are owned by other agents:

- **`~/projects/second-road`** — the macro/2D companion game. Another agent owns
  `src/`, `web/`, `tools/` and `HANDOFF.md` there, and treats this repo as
  **read-only upstream**, consumed through its `npm run sync`. **Do not edit that
  repo.** `tools/gen-world-export.mjs` lives *here* and is ours; if Second Road
  needs the export shape, the baton fields or the art conventions to change, that
  is **requested through the user, not made across the boundary.**
- **`web/portraits/`, `scripts/gen-portraits.py`, the thumbnail track** — the art
  agent's. Consumer wiring (`_avatarSrc`, `web/js/portrait-thumbs.js`) is ours.

**`scripts/gen-portraits.py` REGENERATES EVERY PORTRAIT.** Running it rewrites all
~315 PNGs as pixel art, which silently clobbers the art agent's full-size SDXL
renders. After adding a CHARS spec and running it, restore theirs immediately:
`git status --porcelain web/portraits/ | awk '$1=="M"{print $2}' | xargs git checkout --`
— that leaves only your new `??` files. Verify with
`find web/portraits -maxdepth 1 -size +100k | wc -l` — **take that count BEFORE
you run the generator and check it is unchanged after**, rather than against a
number written here. The render track grows whenever the art agent ships (72 on
2026-08-08, 84 by the next morning), so a hard-coded figure goes stale and the
next person reads a healthy tree as a disaster.

**Use targeted `git add <paths>`, never `git add -A`.** Other agents work in this
same checkout; a blanket add on 2026-08-08 swept 72 of the art agent's in-flight
files into an unrelated commit and pushed it. Check `git status` for untracked
work that isn't yours before committing.

## Commands

No build step, no lint, no npm install for the app — plain HTML/CSS/JS served as-is. The only exception is the browser E2E below, which is dev-only tooling; the app itself never needs a build or install.

```sh
# Run all tests (Node 18+) — the fast vm suite, install-free (gates deploy alongside e2e)
node --test

# Run a single test file
node --test tests/js/engine.test.js

# Ad-hoc headless feel-check — loads the whole engine (cwd-proof) and runs a snippet
# with G / run() / out / show() / lastOut() / sandbox() in scope. Use this instead of
# re-typing the vm-load boilerplate.
node tools/probe.mjs 'sandbox(); G.room="stinky_bar"; run("buy man drink"); show()'

# Run the game locally
open web/index.html   # works from file://, no network requests

# Browser E2E smoke test (one-time setup, then run)
npm install                       # installs @playwright/test (dev only)
npx playwright install chromium   # downloads the headless browser
npm run test:e2e                  # drives web/index.html in headless Chromium
```

Deploy is automatic: any push to `main` runs `.github/workflows/pages.yml` (tests gate the deploy), which publishes `web/` to the `gh-pages` branch. Live at https://soisanuk.github.io/last-baht-bus/.

**Testing cheats:** `CHEATS_ENABLED` (a `let` in engine-core.js — no build step, so the constant is the switch) gates hidden typed codes. **Currently `true`; the intended production default is `false`** — flip it before a real release. Codes are deliberately not surfaced (no autocomplete/decoration): `twoweekmillionaire` grants ฿2,000,000 for spending (handled early in `doCommand`, works in any state, costs no turn). **Hidden display toggles** (same unsurfaced treatment, but NOT gated on `CHEATS_ENABLED` — display modes, not advantages): `TOGGLE_V0` / `TOGGLE_V1` flip the visual layers (the v0 scene panel — **default ON** since the art shipped; v1 hotspots, default OFF) — intercepted in main.js's `_dispatch` (presentation, so the prefs are localStorage `lbb_v0_on`/`lbb_v1_on` read by scene.js, never `G`). Separately, the panel's **fold** (`lbb_scene_off`, the `▸ scene` / `▾ hide scene` toggle in the panel) hides art + cast and keeps HUD + exits; **phones (≤767px) boot folded** unless the pref says otherwise — measured 2026-08-22, the open panel left a 390×844 transcript 38% of the screen — and term.js prints a one-time tip (`lbb_scene_tip`).

## Architecture

Zork-style text adventure in the Soi Sanuk / Pattaya universe. Same conventions as the trainer (`/Users/mario/thaicab`): **classic script tags sharing globals, no ES modules, no build step, works from `file://`**. The root `package.json` `"type": "module"` exists only so `node --test` treats test files as ESM. Load order in `index.html` matters (`thai → world → games → engine-core → engine-encounters → engine-play → engine-systems → engine-parser → …`); `main.js` loads last.

**Every player-facing option lives on three surfaces** — the typed parser (and its printed lists), the flyout wheel (`_kwActions`, term.js), and the input autocomplete (`engineComplete`/`_completePool`, engine.js). When adding, gating, or removing an option, change all three: put the rule in one engine-side helper (`_topicKnown`, `_travelDests`, `_playOptions`, `_c4Choices`, `_jpChoices`, `_gameVerbs`, `_salengItems` are the pattern) and have every surface consume it, then check `_kwActions` and `_completePool` for the affected verb before calling it done.

**Repeatable prose is pooled, never a fixed string.** Any player-facing line printed on an action that repeats — buy/move/eat/flirt/re-enter a room — ships a robust variant pool picked via `_pickVary(pool, key)` (engine-core.js: random with a one-deep, per-`key` no-repeat memory). Deep pools (6–10) for the hottest lines, ~4 elsewhere; fixed strings are for genuinely one-time beats only. Pools live by their handler as `const _UPPER_LINES = [...]` (e.g. `_LADY_DRINK_LINES`/`_BEER_LINES`/`_WATER_LINES`/`_TOASTIE_LINES`/`_STALL_EAT_LINES` in engine-parser.js, `_SOCIAL_TEXT`/`_HOSP_WHY` in engine-play.js, `_SALENG_VIGNETTES` in engine-encounters.js, per-room `revisit: [...]` rendered by `_describeRoom`). When adding an NPC/quest/verb/encounter/room, pool every repeated line it prints. Test against the pool global (`_TOASTIE_LINES.some(s => out.includes(s))`), never a single string, and verify non-flaky over ~8 full-suite runs.

**Prose that asserts something about the world is a CLAIM — check before you invent.** The characteristic defect of generated prose is not a typo, it's an assertion that's fine on its own page and false about the world (Tan drove a minibus in the intro and a grey sedan everywhere else; his *"Come, I know a place"* promised a scene that didn't exist). Per-string review structurally cannot catch this, because contradiction needs co-location and writing never co-locates. So: before inventing a detail about a recurring entity (vehicle, home province, age, workplace, price), run **`node tools/prose-corpus.mjs --about <subject>`** — the dossier pivot regroups every record by who/what it's about, so all the game's existing claims read as one document. **An invitation is a promise** (*come / follow me / I'll show you*): either a verb delivers it or don't write it — and if one does, add the tappable `(CAPS)` hint so the promise lint can see it. **Numbers belong to constants** — concatenate `BEER_PRICE`, never type the digits. Full write-up: `docs/prose-defects.md`. The corpus tool covers declarative tables, engine pools (`pool`), and function-body `_say` prose (`fn`); `--delta` after any prose change, `--stats` for coverage. **The promise-side sibling is the EXAMINE-audit** (`node tools/examine-audit.mjs`, `--room <id>` for one room): it harvests every object noun the room prose advertises, stands in the room, actually runs `EXAMINE <noun>`, and reports the dead-ends — the class that produced the candy_bar photos, the bar shrine, and the beach spirit house, each found by the player stubbing a toe on it. Genre furniture that dead-ends in many rooms wants ONE context-aware `_SCENERY` entry (engine-parser.js — `bar/pub/sand/street` pools or a room-aware `fn`), a distinctive one-room object wants a room `reads:` entry or an ITEMS record, and a mention the mechanics can't honour wants the prose softened. Run it after authoring rooms; the singleton tail is triage-on-demand, not a gate. **EXAMINE is state-aware, four ways** (2026-08-15): (1) a `reads:` value may be an **array of gated nodes** `{req, notFlags, text, sets?, reveal?}` resolved first-match like dialogue — a close look changes once you know things (the Orchid's good table pre/post `orchidReported`, Mort's notebook pre/post `jokeWho`, the Shamrock fixtures list post `seanStory`); the LAST node must be ungated (reads.test enforces), and `reveal: itemId` places a hidden `location: null` item in the room (used ONCE — the Shamrock hatch's brass key, the second-bar seed; keep reveal scarce or players examine-grind). A reads noun only fires if registered in `_READ_NOUNS` — the recurring bug is authoring the reads entry and forgetting the registration. Fixtures outrank look-resolution (`_roomRead` peek runs before `_findNpc`/`_findPatron`, so EXAMINE NOTEBOOK reads the notebook, not the man holding it), and `_roomRead(arg, peek)` exists because `_doExamine` truthy-checks before `_doRead` resolves — effects (sets/reveal/noticer-log) fire only on the non-peek call. (2) **Bond-aware people**: a courted lady's close-up appends a `_BOND_LOOK` tier overlay (face/regular/her-farang) under her desc — the drinks ledger made visible. (3) **State-aware scenery**: the bell reads differently while `_bellActive`, the checkpoint honours its 18:00–19:00 window, EXAMINE RAIN reads `G.rain`/`_wxRainy` (prose only, no dice), EXAMINE ME appends an honest clause at drunk ≥6 / hurt ≥2 / jaded ≥4, and EXAMINE STAIRCASE answers by venue (soi6/gogo/gents/QV — the game's most important unstated fixture). (4) **The noticer loop**: `_roomRead` logs authored-fixture examines into `G.examined` ("room.key"), and the Owl's letter slot (`_OWL_NOTICED`, engine-systems.js) day-stably alternates in a reader's letter about a fixture the player actually examined — the player is never named, the coincidence is the wink; grow the map alongside flagship `reads:` entries.

**Command-hint idiom** (what makes prose tappable): only ALL-CAPS *inside literal parentheses* decorates into a cmd kw — CAPS outside parens are plain emphasis, so put every actionable hint in parens and keep non-commands out of them (no CAPS room labels or stray `ON`/`BLACK` inside a paren group; note parens match across newlines). `<placeholders>` fold into the kw and make it an open prefill (`SEND <amount> TO <name>` → prefills `send `), even mid-phrase — never leaves orphan `TO`/`FOR` kws. `[x]` deliberately ends the capture so the base command fires as-is (`PLAY JACKPOT [bet]` → fires `play jackpot`). Modal screens must keep their options parenthesized and complete (`(FLIP 3 4 · FLIP 7)`, the checkout hotel list, `(NEW VACATION · MOVE TO PATTAYA)`), and modal state owns autocomplete (`_gameVerbs`, `G.pendingChoice` branches in `engineComplete`).

**The game is a staged sandbox.** `G.stage`: `act1` (the wallet quest, day 2 of a 7-day vacation) → `vacation` (Act One complete: `_checkAct1` fires once at `hotel_room`, gated in `_doGo` on `hasWallet`, scores the quest, converts score to happiness, and opens the room safe +฿3000) → `expat` (chosen at week's end; endless, +฿20000 savings; future home of the run-your-own-bar mechanic). `G.over` is never set; the long-game stat is `G.happy` (สนุก), fed by `_addHappy(n)` hooks across every system. Levels at 0/10/25/50/100; 100 = สบายสบาย, celebrated once via the `sabaiSabai` flag but non-terminal.

**Character creation — the taxi-ride intro** (Phase A shipped; dialogue-only for v1). Before either scenario opens, **Tan** the airport driver-fixer runs a 3-question "who are you?" beat on the ride in — a `pendingChoice="intro"` modal (`_taxiIntro`/`_introPrompt`/`_introAnswer`/`_introMatch`, dispatched by `G.introAfter` = `"beach"|"soi6"`), then he drops you on Soi 6 and the chosen opening runs (`_beachOpening(withTitle)` for the full game / `_soi6Opening` after `_soi6Setup` for the challenge — `startSoi6Mode` split accordingly). The three axes are `ORIGINS` (7) / `PERSONALITIES` (5) / `ORIENTATIONS` (straight·bi, gay stubbed) in world.js, each entry `{id,label,pick,tan}` (Tan's read on your answer). They land in `G.player.{origin,personality,orientation}`; read via `_isOrigin`/`_pers`/`_orient` (all false before the intro, so old saves behave unchanged). **Identity persists across resets** — `_act1Fail` and `startSoi6Mode` capture `G.player` across their `newGame()` and restore it (RESTART clears it → re-picks). Modal wired the standard way: doCommand intercept + `_renderResume` case + `_chipSet` numbered answers; the E2E `bootIntoGame` helper answers the three picks; `beforeEach` in engine.test.js defaults an identity (monger/joker/straight) so non-intro tests open the beach not the taxi. `WHO AM I`/`IDENTITY` (`_doWhoAmI`) reports it. **Planned (Phase B):** the 7 origins become NPCs on Soi 6 (the one you picked deactivated — you ARE him), each with a quest; **Tan is the hidden hub** (drove them all, the PI's "contact", connects every thread — a replay-reward tie, never obvious); orientation/bi routing (katoey/Peacock become courtship); NPC `personality`; showcase `when(st,G)` gates. See the `lbb-character-creation` memory.

**FOLLOW, and eating with Tan.** `FOLLOW <who>` (`_doFollow`) exists mostly so Tan's standing invitation — his good-table deflection ends *"you eat yet? You never eat. Come, I know a place."* — is a real door and not an undelivered promise (a playtest catch; the corpus review can't see promises, only strings). `_tanFood` is the scene: a cart round the corner (no room change, so soi6 mode stays one street), pooled prose + a separate table-talk pool, ~55 hunger / 20 thirst, +2 non-jading สนุก, 5 ticks, **he always pays** (the fare is conversational, same as the ride). Once per night (`G.soc.tanFedDay`) so it can't farm the hunger meter, and refused during Act One (the wallet comes first — same voice as phone-Tan). `EAT WITH TAN` routes to the same scene from `_doEat`. Everyone else gets a voiced refusal (`_FOLLOW_NO` / `_FOLLOW_NOBODY`) — the house rule is that a plausible verb never dead-ends in "I didn't understand that". Three-surfaced: parser case + `_COMPLETE_VERBS`/completion targets + a `follow` key in `_npcActions` (Tan only, gated on `act1Done`) rendered as "eat with him" on the wheel, plus the tappable `(FOLLOW TAN)` hint in his own line.

**The daily challenge + the share card** (Soi 6 mode). `startSoi6Mode(opts)` takes optional `{seed, dailyId}` — the **frontend** computes today's date string and hashes it through `_dailySeed` (pure FNV-1a → the LCG's range, engine-parser.js), so the engine never reads a clock (rule 1) and everyone who presses **TODAY'S SOI** (the second button on the start-intro panel, main.js `_startGame(true)`) gets the same dice stream + the same stable-hash week. PLAY AGAIN/RESTART call with no opts = always a fresh non-daily roll. `G.nightLog` (capped 30) records every `_endNight` reason; `_shareCard()` renders the Wordle-style card — one `_NIGHT_EMOJI` per night (outcome class only, never content), pending nights pad with `·`, สนุก + pocket + the site URL — printed automatically by `_endVacation` in soi6 mode and by the **SHARE** verb (three-surfaced: parser case + `_COMPLETE_VERBS` + a vacation_end chip + `_HELP_SOI6`; SHARE also answers *through* the vacation_end gate). main.js's `_dispatch` intercepts `share` to additionally copy `_shareCard().join("\n")` to the clipboard (presentation — the engine stays clipboard-free). E2E: `tests/e2e/sharecard.spec.mjs` (button → seeded daily → card → clipboard).

**The clock and the body.** Nights are `NIGHT_TURNS` (100) long, 10 turns/hour from 18:00; `_tick` accrues hunger/thirst, sobers you 1 drink per 20 turns, drains happiness when meters redline, and calls `_endNight(reason)` on collapse (hunger/thirst 100), blackout (drunk ≥ 9 via `_checkDrunk`), hospital (`G.hurt` ≥ 3), or dawn. `_endNight` resets dailies (hangover scales next evening's hunger/thirst), advances `G.day`, and respawns you by whether you **made it home**: SLEEP at your hotel (or being in your room at dawn) → your room, battery 100, cash kept; but `dawn`/`collapse`/`blackout` without getting home are **rough wakes** (`_crashSpotFor`) — you come to at a crash spot in the region you passed out in (jomtien_beach / beach_rd_c / ws_gate / buakhao_market / naklua_rd / **sukhumvit_crossing**, the last stranding you east of the highway), battery low and **wallet emptied** (unless `G.dog` is watching — see Companions; `G.jaded` untouched); `barfine`/`robbed`/`hurt` keep their bed logic. **Rough wakes are a RESIDENT mechanic** — during the opening quest (before `act1Done`) a `dawn`/`collapse`/`blackout` is instead a **hard fail** (`_act1Fail`): the game RESETS (`newGame()` + `engineIntro()`, back to the beach, day two) rather than waking you rough. The one thing carried across the reset is `G.act1Best` — a high-water mark of how far down the opening critical path you got (`_act1Progress` counts ticked `_ACT1_MILESTONES`, 0–7), shown on the fail screen (★ personal-best) and echoed in the intro so each attempt measures against your best. So the get-home opening is genuinely do-or-die; the sandbox's soft rough-wake only kicks in once you've made it home the first time. (`RESTART` and `_act1Fail` both preserve `act1Best`/`act1Tries`; the frontend's "start fresh" continue-prompt is a clean slate.) **The round-2 HINT system** softens the difficulty spike: `_act1Fail` bumps `G.act1Tries` (also carried across the reset), and once it's ≥1 the **HINT** verb (`_doHint`, three-surfaced: parser case + `_COMPLETE_VERBS` + a tappable `(HINT)` in the intro + `_HELP`) whispers the next step, keyed to the first unreached `_ACT1_MILESTONE` (`_ACT1_HINTS`; the endgame hint names both the polite wai-Oy route and the safe-crack). First run it's deliberately coy (no spoilers before you've earned the whisper). **In the sandbox** (`act1Done`) the same verb reuses the "next actionable step" idea for the **quest journal**: it points at one active quest (name + `desc` + where to go), else nudges an offer (`ACCEPT <QUEST>`), else the givers-are-out-there line. A quest's optional **`at:`** field (an NPC id *or* a room id) is resolved to a **live** location clause by `_questWhere` — where the person actually is TODAY (`_npcRoom`, so it survives NPC movement), which venue (`_barName`), and the region — self-suppressed when you're already there. `_questWhere` is the single source of "where" (quest `desc`s carry the action + tappable CAPS command only, no baked-in venue), shared by HINT **and** the `QUESTS` journal so they always agree. A broke player stranded at the Sukhumvit crossing gets a piwin **pity-ride** to town (`_doMotosai`: ฿0 to any town-ward dest when `G.money === 0`, never deeper into the dark) — no soft-lock. **The last baht bus** (`LAST_BUS_TURN` = 80 ≈ 02:00, the titular climax): the cheap ฿15 songthaew ride home has a curfew — `_doRideBus` refuses after it ("the last songthaew… rattled off to the depot"), and `_lastBusWarn` (from `_tick`, once/night via `G.lastBusWarned`, gated to residents out of the hotel) fires a heads-up in the final half hour (nightTurn 75–79) to break for a main road. Miss it and getting home is the **piwin's small-hours gouge** (`_doMotosai` ×`LATE_MOTO_MULT` 1.6 after the cutoff — the pity-ride and Bank's ฿20 mates'-rate stay exempt; the gouged fare is quoted in Thai, the fare-reading hook), the **free-but-dark walk** (TRAVEL/GO home costs ticks + soi-dog/battery risk, and can dawn you out mid-route), or a **rough wake**. `TIME` surfaces the bus's status. So the night-end is a real decision, not a free teleport home. day > 7 outside expat triggers `_endVacation` → `G.pendingChoice = "vacation_end"` gate → `_newVacation()` (happy resets, `bestHappy` tracks, no lead-in) or `_goExpat()`. Food/water via `FOOD_STALLS`/`_doEat`, plus `room.seven` (one street room per district) selling the cheese toastie/water/charger. BARFINE via `_doBarfine`: favor-gated, then a **ST/LT negotiation gate** (`G.pendingBf` — a full modal: doCommand intercept + `_bfPrompt` + `_renderResume` + its own completion pool; SHORT TIME/LONG TIME/NO are tappable CAPS). Prices from `_barfinePrices` (ST = old `_barfinePrice`: ×1.5 before 21:00, beer waived after midnight except `POPULAR_GIRLS`, ×0.75 late; LT = ST × beer 1.75 / gogo 1.5 / **soi6 ×3 early — prohibitive, beats a go-go — ×2 mid**; **after midnight LT === ST everywhere**). On Soi 6 the girl quotes upfront (volume business); elsewhere the mamasan/cashier drifts over — the girl gets a cut and never names the number, and `_maybeGoWithYou` (favor 4-5, once/girl/night, piggybacked on `_maybeSelfBarfine`'s call sites) has her open the subject sideways: "I go with you, na". **ST** = one round: pay, +5 (soi6/gents +6, **on-site** — Soi 6 upstairs / the gents-club curtained couch, no take-out tick), ~6 ticks, the night carries on, and `G.soc.bfBar[room]` marks that a girl left this bar with you. **LT** = overnight: `_endNight("barfine")` +10 (base `G.lastBfBase`, reset nightly) — unless she runs a game, or the night hands you **too much reality** (`_bfResolve` honest-LT path, a per-(girl,day) hash ~30%): instead of the grand fantasy she becomes a whole *person* — the life story, the tears, the five-year-girlfriend morning — dropping `G.lastBfBase` to 4 (less สนุก, the escape that didn't escape) but paying **+6 bond** (double the honest +3: you saw the real her). A **draw** commands a premium — `_barfinePrice` marks her base ×1.5 and gives her **no** midnight discount. **The hedonic treadmill** (`_conquestHappy(base)`, `G.jaded`): every genuine conquest happy (barfine LT +10, ST +5/+6, freelancer threesome +7, `booking` hit +8) runs through it — each buys 2 สนุก less than the last (floored −4), so a binge night goes +6→+4→+2→0→−2; `G.jaded` cools 1/day and resets each vacation, and presence/courtship/company/quests never touch it, so the slow road to สบายสบาย stays fully rewarding. **The Regular** (persistent relationship — the treadmill's matched pair): `G.soc.drinks[id]` already aggregates every kind of attention and persists within a vacation, so it IS the bond; `_bondTier(id)` reads it (drinks 0/3/7/13 → stranger/face/regular/**her-farang**). Payoffs: **recognition** (`_relGreeting` on arrival — she remembers you → kept seat → the name she uses for nobody else, once/bar/night); **depth beats breadth** (a bonded regular+ conquest passes `id` to `_conquestHappy` for +2 and **no jaded** — one deepening girl stays rewarding while churn jades); **off-book** (at her-farang tier the barfine is WAIVED — she squares it with the mamasan herself, in `_bfResolve`). Accrual: ST +2 / honest LT +3 (only on honest outcomes, **after** the scam roll, so it can't inflate favor past `_bfExploitable`); souring: barfining another girl in front of a regular of yours docks her bond; decay −1/night (`_endNight`), reset per vacation. `G.lastBfId` hooks the LT ending's `_conquestHappy`, cleared in the freelancer path so freelancers get no bond bonus. **Reputation** (`G.rep`, engine-core.js — the town-wide sibling to the per-girl bond and per-bar heat): a single signed scalar (−20..+20) = the soi's collective read on you, distinct from bond/trust/heat/faction. Moved by `_repGain()` (a good deed, **throttled to +1/day** shared across all sources via `G.repDay`) and `_repHit(n)` (an incident — **uncapped, stacks within a night**); `_repTier()` → −2..+2, labelled by `_REP_LABELS`. **Deliberately asymmetric** (slow to build, quick to lose): a clean 7-day trip tops ~+7 ("a good sort"), +10 ("a face on the soi") is an expat-length haul, one bad night undoes a week. Gains: ฿100+ tip / man-drink / quest-done / on-time loan / an honest-consistent `_convoAnswer`. Losses: `_kickOut` (−3), grapevine catch (direct −2 / gossip −1 in `_convoAnswer`), jilting a regular in front of the bar (−2). Effects are **flavor-forward** (economy untouched): a ±1 `_favor` bias for **strangers only** (bond<3, never overrides earned bond), a `_repArrival` stranger-bar greeting at the ±2 tiers only (once/bar/night, shares `G.soc.greeted`), and the **STANDING / REP** readout (`_doRep`) + a line in WHO AM I. Gated on `act1Done`, **resets per vacation** (`_newVacation`), **persists into expat** (you live there). Player-local, so it stays per-player in a future shared world (rule #7). One scalar, not per-axis — grep `_rep` in engine-*.js. **Bond-tiered dialogue:** `_pickDialogue` skips `bond:N` entries below tier N (hand-authored NPCs opt in, in their own English register); filler hostesses get a generic Tinglish `_bondTalk` at regular+ (incl. the phone-Google-Translate deep-talk beat). **Bond-scaled texting** (`_maybeIncomingText`): regulars/farang-tier contacts text more often, are weighted-likelier to be the sender, and skew to invites/longing ("when you come see me??") with no mama-sick scam-ask on their own farang. **WHO / BLACKBOOK** (`_doBlackbook`) is the relationship dashboard — contacts ranked by bond with where she works and any invite. Adding that verb followed the three-surfaces rule (parser case + `_COMPLETE_VERBS` + a `(WHO / BLACKBOOK)` hint in CONTACTS + a `_HELP` line; a global readout needs no `_kwActions`). **The open contract** (answering PAY/YES without terms) is the newbie mistake: `_bfExploitable` girls (`_bfShark` — a stable ~35% hash-pick of non-popular, non-green girls; favor ≥6 or wingman keeps everyone honest) charge LT×1.3 and scam at 0.6 instead of 0.3. **Refusals** (`_bfRefusal`, before the negotiation): customer-stealing via `bfBar` (a colleague left with you tonight — the old "second same-bar barfine" canon, now built), smell at drunk ≥6 (recoverable sober), cheap-charlie/dislike at favor < gate+2 (cheap recoverable at +2 favor), and stable per-(girl,day) life-hash reasons — the HONEST lady-time told BEFORE money moves, or temple in the morning; refusals stick for the night (`soc.bfRefused`). **Two non-held refusals** (re-evaluated each ask, so they lift/return on their own): a **draw** (`_isDraw` — a ~15% per-vacation hash-pick) is a bar's prized girl the mama won't release before midnight (`nightTurn < 60`) — a gouge quote that's really a NO, lifting after midnight at a premium (see pricing); and a **kept girl** (`_hasSponsor` ~18%) whose long-time sponsor is in town this vacation (`_sponsorInTown`, a ~3-day window) isn't working — except his one **family night** (`_sponsorFamilyDay`), when she's free. **The games** (`_bfScamRoll` kinds): period-reveal after payment (night continues, mama right there), runner/mao/leaveAfter (`_endNight("bfscam")` variants, reduced happy), and the interactive `bfhop`/`bfparty` pendingEnc sequences (kickback bar-hop, Walking Street three-girl party — NO at any step buys back the clean LT night). **The night ride** (`nightride` pendingEnc, `_nightRide`/`_endRide` + `_RIDE_VENUES`/`_RIDE_HOP` data) is `bfhop`'s deliberate warm mirror — offered on an LT barfine of a **bonded** lady (`_bondTier ≥ 2`, day-stable roll 55%/80% by tier), she takes you off the tourist map on the back of her bike: **pure serendipity** (each stop random from the venue pool — Thai disco / 2am som tam / WS superclub / host-bar karaoke / her friend's real bar / the Pratumnak viewpoint / night market — you only choose RIDE ON or call it). No fleece (real modest costs, `G.money < RIDE_MIN_CASH` ends it gracefully), each stop pays **non-jading** `_addHappy` +bond, capped at `RIDE_MAX_STOPS`; a 4+-stop ride is "the one you'll chase." Ends via `_endNight("barfine")` with `G.lastBfBase` scaled by stops — and since **she's your ride, the last-bus dread doesn't apply** (the run's core anxiety lifts for the one bonded night). `G.rideSeq` holds the sequence. All non-leaveAfter incidents set `G.bfIncident` → **COMPLAIN** (`_doComplain`, at her bar with the mamasan present; conditionally in autocomplete): refund + a vouched intro (+2 drinks-favor with a popular/green girl there), leaveAfter gets the shrug, second strike (`bfStrikes`) = the apology-from-her-own-purse scene. Mama's motive is business, not morality. Nigel and Randy carry the veteran warning sermons (topic "barfine"). The `freelancer` encounter (Beach Road/promenade) undercuts a barfine (฿700 solo / ฿1400 with Ning) but rolls her kind: mostly safe (+happy, threesome is the biggest single hit), else `_endNight("robbed")` lifts most of your remaining cash + any shades/Rolex — the canon "no mamasan, no recourse" downside. Not everyone is working: `bkktourist`/`jptourist` are non-transactional encounters where money is the *wrong* verb (it insults them, −happy); manners earn a free moment, and the Japanese traveller two-steps (offer re-arms `pendingEnc`) into a dancer threesome. The `tonic` hair-tonic tout (Beach Road street rooms only) is also a two-step: the friendly ฿99 street bottle is a soft option, but following him to the SHOP re-arms `pendingEnc` into `_tonicShop` — high-pressure side-soi sales (PAY = full `TONIC_FLEECE`; try to LEAVE = a `_rand()<0.5` nerve-vs-muscle flip, muscle coercing `TONIC_SHAKEDOWN`; a broke mark is shoved out free; **TAO RAI at the street pitch** pays the honest hook price and closes the encounter before the shop can open — the fortune teller's ฿199 reading likewise — and `G.dog` voids the muscle in both LEAVE branches). Whatever's taken banks in `G.tonicOwed`, recoverable via the **REPORT** verb at `police_station` (`_doReport`) for `owed − round(owed×TONIC_POLICE_CUT)` — the canon "brown envelope" cut. The `fortune` encounter (Beach Road) is the tonic's sibling — a monk-robed **curse-removal** con: a ฿199 palm reading re-arms `pendingEnc` into `_curseRitual`'s ฿1,900 "cleansing" (PAY / try to LEAVE = nerve-vs-pressure), banked in `G.curseOwed` and clawed back by the same generalised **REPORT** (`_doReport` now handles tonicOwed + curseOwed). **Nira's loan** (Neon Paradise): BORROW ≤฿20k at +20% (ยี่สิบ) due in 3 days, REPAY partial/whole (on-time pays bond); `_loanNightRoll` in `_endNight` escalates a late `G.loan` — warning text → cousins asking around → they garnish carried cash while the balance compounds 20%/night; cleared by `_newVacation`. The `booking` encounter (late — nightTurn ≥ 40, act1Done, hotel rooms + Naklua, `nightly`) is the **app-catfish**: YES → a photos-vs-reality roll, ~45% a ฿2,500 on-site 10/10 (a conquest, feeds the treadmill), else the catfish two-step (`_catfishDoor`: STAY sunk-cost / SEND her off with a ฿300 taxi token). `nightly:true` encounters restock each night — `_endNight` deletes all of them from `G.encDone`, not just `freelancer`. `britles` (British lesbian) and `punterwife` (Filipina wife) extend the non-transactional set: hands-on gets a confrontation, money gets a rebuff, and good vibes grant a **wingman** buff — `G.wingmanUntil = G.turns + WINGMAN_TURNS`, checked by `_wingman()`, worth +2 in `_favor` for its duration. `_maybeSelfBarfine` (favor ≥6, after midnight, once/night) sets `pendingEnc:"selfbf"`. Vacation stage: cash comes from the street ATM — WITHDRAW/CHECK BALANCE draws on `G.bank` (฿300 fee per pull, ฿20,000/day cap via `G.atmDay`). Drunk ≥5 on lit streets rolls the repeatable `police` pseudo-encounter (30-turn cooldown via `G.lastPolice`); an adjacent `mamaTreat` bar's mamasan rescues at 70%. **Midnight closing** (`_closingTick`, from `_tick`; helpers `_closesMidnight`/`_closedNow`/`_closedMsg`, plus a 30-min **last call** `_lastCall` at nightTurn 55 — once/bar/night, on arrival too — nudging a BARFINE before the shutters): gentleman's clubs (`gents` barType), most of Soi 6 (`soi6` barType), and Darkside bars all close at 60 (midnight); the Queen Vic pub and the town's beer bars/go-gos run to dawn. The `_closedNow` gate lives in `_arriveAt` so fast-travel is covered. On the Darkside — a bar with `lockIn: true` (Night Heron, Daeng's) whose player has spent freely tonight (`_barSpendTonight`: a bell, a mama treat, or 3+ lady drinks on its girls) BOLTS the door instead: `G.soc.lockIn[room]` (nightly reset with soc), +3 `_favor` in the room, PG-13 wild-party prose, saleng spawns blocked, `_describeRoom` re-announces like rain. OUT is one-way (bolt goes back behind you); entering any Darkside bar after 60 that isn't actively locked-in gets the shutters line. Window shoppers get walked out at midnight (gents/Soi-6 bars the same). **Gentleman's clubs** (`gents` barType — enclosed AC villas off the beaten path, e.g. the Orchid Club in Naklua; open through the afternoon) are the hands-on venue: buying a lady ONE drink adds +6 `_favor` room-side (`_favor` gents branch — cold until you do, so kiss/spank/fondle then reciprocate), ST is on-site, barfine base `BF_GENTS` ฿900 (LT ×1.5), and the enclosed villa takes no saleng cart. Darkside filler hostesses draw from `_H_LOOK_DARK` (older/experienced — never the green C4 tier). **The bar manager** is a distinct NPC type marked `manager: true` on the NPCS entry — deliberately **NOT in `NPC_ROLES`**, so all lady-logic (barfine/lady-drink/tip/contact) ignores him (Bert at Stinky's is the exemplar: hired help, not the owner — there's a separate ailing American owner; Candy's bf and Stinky's silent-partner/shadow-mamasan). Behaviours: `_managerWelcome` (from `_arriveAt`) pours a **free house shot** once per bar per night (`G.soc.mgrShot`, sandbox only, +1 สนุก +1 drunk); leaning on his time via TALK bumps `G.soc.mgrChat` and at 3 he nudges for a **man drink**; **BUY MAN DRINK** / BUY DRINK FOR `<manager>` (`_buyManDrink`, `BEER_PRICE`) builds `G.soc.manDrinks` goodwill and clears the nudge. Three-surfaced: `_doBuy` routes manager targets *before* the lady-drink branch, autocomplete splices "man drink" early (survives the 8-cap), a `(BUY MAN DRINK)` tap-hint in the prose. Deferred: reading-customers adaptivity, interrupt-annoyance, burnout/turnover, and Candy's *actual* shadow-visits (her `bars` rotation is `day % len` and Act One is day 2, so adding stinky_bar would move her off Candy Bar and break the wallet chain — kept as flavor for now).

Bar social life lives in `G.soc` (per-girl lady-drink counts, per-bar bell/heat/ban/patron state, own drunk counter). Actions (`_doSocial`: flirt/kiss/spank/fondle) resolve `_favor(id) − SEV[kind]` into five outcome tiers; `NPC_ROLES` (world.js) caps physical contact for cashiers/mamasans until `bells[room] ≥ 2`. **The bell escalates the whole room while its glow holds** (`_bellLevel` = `bells[room]` when `_bellActive`): `_favor` gains +2/+4/+10 at 1/2/3 rings, so two bells make everyone much friendlier and three bells top-tier every action (hands-on reciprocate); at three, `_addHeat` is amnestied entirely (no repercussions). Heat ≥ 3 → `_kickOut()` (LK Metro bans complex-wide; bans expire after `BAN_TURNS`). Street attempts are negative except the katoey encounter's flirt-back branch. `_doThrowCover` (THROW COVER / NIPPLE COVER / PASTIE [AT <lady>]) is the ceiling-game bit — needs a hostess present and `_favor ≥ 2` for the ammunition, then rolls `_rand()` for stick-time and who it lands on (back on you / another girl = happy; the regular = `patronMiffed` + heat; the mamasan = heat 2). Player-initiated so the dice are fine. `BUY BRA FOR <lady>` (`BRA_PRICE` ฿200, favor ≥ 2) sets `G.soc.bra[id]`, which adds a `braBump` of +2 to net inside `_doSocial` for `fondle` only — one tier warmer; resets nightly with the rest of `G.soc`.

**Hotels** (`_HOTELS`, `G.hotel`: sabai/queenvic/metropole): after Act One, CHECKOUT (`_doCheckout`, in your own room, `nightTurn < 10`) lists the two hotels you're not in (`G.pendingChoice = "checkout"` gates the reply). Rooms: `hotel_room` (Sabai Palms, Naklua), `qv_room` (Queen Vic balcony), `metropole_room` (Metropole tower; `alley` exit = fire stairs into LK Metro). `_doGo` refuses hotel rooms that aren't yours; `_chargeRent` runs at wake — vacation rates 400/700/1300, expat long-stay 270/400/730 — and on failure steps down `_HOTEL_DOWNGRADE` toward the Sabai, then books debt (`G.hotelDebt`, capped `_DEBT_CAP` ฿2000, −1 happy per indebted morning, auto-settled when flush). Debt ≥ ฿800 + entering Stinky/Candy Bar = the once-per-game grace note (`tabSettled` flag). Perks: Sabai = −1 hangover at wake but a ฿300 joiner fee on take-out barfine endings; Queen Vic = `WATCH SOI` (`_doWatchSoi`, +1 happy/night — shares `G.blueDogDay` with the Blue Dog show, deliberately: one "spectator" point a night); Metropole = the robbed ending loses ≤฿1000 and keeps valuables. New vacations and `_goExpat` re-book the Sabai. All hotel perks/fees gate on `_flag("act1Done") && G.stage !== "act1"` — keep new ones consistent.

**Named patrons** (`PATRONS` in world.js — separate from `NPCS`): bar customers with `{name, emoji, age, nat, home, hops, days?, avoids?, desc, dialogue}`. Position is the pure hash `_patronRoom(id)` — hoppers get a hash-picked bar per (vacation, day, hour) until 22:00 (`_patronHour() >= 4`) then settle at `home`; `days` (weekday indices, `G.day % 7`, Monday = 1) keeps a patron home on work nights (David: `[1,5]`); `avoids` lists bars the hop hash skips (Danny: his creditors' bars — keep narrative "he never goes there" claims mechanically true this way). `_patronsHere`/`_findPatron`/`_patronTalk` parallel the NPC pipeline; dialogue schema matches NPC entries but the seen-index book (`G.patronTalk`) resets daily. Rooms list them as "At the rail: …". Patron cross-topics on NPCs (Bert's `danny`, Drew's `angela`) live in normal NPC dialogue. **Because hoppers move every in-game hour, a tapped name can already be stale** — so the interaction is hardened three ways: (1) `ASK <who> <topic>` parses with OR without the "about" connective (the flyout/autocomplete builds it a word at a time, no "about"), (2) `_doTalk`'s not-found path runs `_elsewhereLine(name)` — a moved regular gets the generic "the regulars drift about" line (promising a hopper's location would go stale by the time you got there), while a **known** named NPC at another bar is *placed* ("Candy isn't at this bar — try Candy Bar"); unmet NPCs and anonymous (lowercase) staff stay a plain "Nobody by that name here" so no location is leaked — and (3) tapping an absent patron in the flyout offers TALK (→ that message) rather than gossip-routing, which is reserved for absent *story* NPCs. `_elsewhereLine` reads `_npcRoom(id)`, so it tracks NPC movement automatically. **NPC movement** (first case: Candy) works through `_npcRoom(id)` — the single source of an NPC's current room. Most NPCs keep a fixed `room`; an owner of several bars carries a `bars: [...]` list and works them on **alternate nights** (`bars[G.day % bars.length]`, day-stable — unlike the hourly patron hop — so a location the player is pointed to stays true till dawn). **Read `_npcRoom(id)`, never `NPCS[id].room`, wherever presence matters** — `_npcsHere`, the mamasan-blessing/rescue, the hotel-debt intercept, ASK-NUMBER, the standing-invite honour, and `_elsewhereLine` all do. `_describeRoom` adds a "she's working <other bar> tonight" line when you're at one of her bars but she's at the other. `_elsewhereLine` reveals a placed location only when `_npcRoom(id)` is one of her *own* `bars` (an invited visit elsewhere, once that's built, stays unrevealed). Phase note: the game opens on **day 2** (even), so Candy is at the original Candy Bar for Act 1's first night; quest hints that name "Candy Bar" stay valid and the elsewhere line covers her odd-night detours to Candy Bar 2. Still planned: invited visits, Bert's multiple bars.

**The flashlight is social** (`_lightNotice`, on room entry and light-on): silent in dark rooms; hostesses tease by name, barmen point at the lights, street NPCs are amused. In a go-go the house assumes a camera — `_gogoLightWarn` escalates per command (a `mark` flag stops the entry notice and the same command's tick double-counting): warning, warning, `_kickOut()`. Turning it off stands security down and resets the count.

**The bar-owning chain** (`bar_premises` → `bar_licence` → `bar_partner` → `bar_opening`, expat only, gated by **`expatLife`** set in `_goExpat`) is the expat stage's reason to exist — `_goExpat`'s closing line promises it, so the chain makes that a door rather than a wink. **The bar is the Stinky Pinky, and that's the design**: you already spent `white_dish` talking Bert out of selling to Ryan Powers, the ailing American owner is still ailing, and holding isn't a plan — so the only buyer who isn't WDG is you, and Gavin loses a bar to a regular. Hence `bar_premises` deps on `white_dish`, and `bar_licence` on `nominee_deal` (**Wayne gives the honest answer about the 51% rule only because you stopped him signing the crooked one**). **Step 3 is a fork**: fifty-one percent has to be a *person*, and the two candidates are **Candy** (slow, a Bangkok lawyer, everything written; `partnerCandy`, indie +2 / wdg −2) and **Tan** (instant, free, land office is his wife's cousin, takes nothing; `partnerTan`, + a `syndicate` bump). Tan has refused money all game — the banking app bounces it back and his own line is *"when I want something from you, I will ask for it — and it will not be money"* — so that route hands the hidden hub 51% of your bar and a debt with no figure on it. **Opening night has one node per route** so the choice is visible at the payoff: Candy's is paperwork pinned behind the till; Tan's has nothing anyone can point at, and Gavin asks whether you know what you've agreed to. **Tan calls the favour in** (`_tanFavour`, engine-systems.js) is the partnerTan payoff and the reason the fork isn't cosmetic: he comes to your bar — which he never does — and asks for a **name on the staff list**, a girl from Nong Khai whose permit is with a company that no longer exists. It is deliberately *small*; what's established is that he can ask. A `pendingChoice = "tanfavour"` modal wired the standard way (arrival trigger in `_arriveAt` → doCommand intercept → `_renderResume` → `_chipSet` → `engineComplete`), answering YES / NO / **ASK** (ASK gives his straight answer and re-prompts). YES: `tanFavourDone`, syndicate +2, and nothing bad ever happens, which is the point. NO: `tanFavourRefused`, **no standing moves at all** — the faction doctrine is that declining is free forever — and the cost is one sentence (he could have written the name himself; he came and asked instead). Once ever, and the Candy route can never see it. Note it establishes new canon: Tan has a wife, whose cousin is at the land office. The dead Shamrock on Soi Khao Talo is deliberately **not** this bar — it's the Darkside, where neither WDG nor the Samsons have any reason to care — and is planted as a second-bar hook in Daeng's dialogue (gated on `barOpen`); the pressure out there would come from local Thai interests, which wants its own faction. Guarded by `tests/js/barchain.test.js`, a scripted playthrough — **the soak cannot reach any quest**: it plays randomly and a dep chain needs talk-until-offered → ACCEPT → travel → a specific ASK, so a five-seed expat run offers zero quests. True of every quest; soak ceilings measure ambient prose only.

**Who the powers actually are** (`docs/factions-thai.md`) — read before writing any of this. Thai organised power is **patronage, not families**: a continuum from respected businessman to person-you-don't-cross with no line where legitimate stops, which is why nothing here is written as a scandal. Two distinct shapes, and the contrast is the design: **Tan is ผู้กว้างขวาง (*phu kwang khwang*, "a broad person") and deliberately NOT a เจ้าพ่อ** — his currency is favours, never money, and the `syndicate` faction is almost fanatically Thai, admitting the player as a useful farang face and never as a member (being inside is *intimate*, the obligation has no figure on it). **The Darkside is a เจ้าพ่อ (*jao pho*) family** — construction, land and contracts, converting into local political office over a generation; it doesn't want your till, it wants the right contractor and no problems (being inside is *overhead*, everything priced). **Influence, not violence**: the syndicate's power is that it never has to act. Violence is contracted out, never in-house, and rare — attention and chaos both wreck a business whose asset is that nobody looks closely — so **the threat is never made, because making it is already a failure**. This is *why* refusing procurement gets nothing done to you: acting would be loud and costly when withdrawal achieves the same at zero risk. The restraint is the menace, nobody ever threatens the player, and it sits on the older house rule that violence never becomes mechanics. **What's in the envelope** (the apparent contradiction, resolved): *Thais deal in favours, foreigners pay cash* — you can only be **owed** a favour if you're inside, so **the envelope is what you pay when you cannot be**. The money on the good table is WDG paying to be *tolerated*, the only reason a foreign rollup operates on Soi 6; which makes the Orchid's good table **not WDG's power seat but their tribute desk** (`orchid_recon` resolves to Tan — the player thinks they're scouting power and is watching rent get collected), and makes **WDG structurally fragile**, since tolerance can be withdrawn where an obligation can't. It also explains Tan's refusal exactly: taking your cash would *settle the account*. **Nobody hands over what actually matters** — the previous owner can't tell you because he never learned it (the Ohio owner had Bert), is too proud to say it, or is dead (Sean); so every advisor is partial in character and **the player never gets a briefing**. Useful vocabulary: ***suay*** (the levy paid to be left alone — what the envelope at the good table is) and ***sen*** ("line", connections — what the cleaning contract actually buys). **Why the Shamrock died**: Daeng's innocent version (Sean went home for an operation) is true, but a bar with no partner has no cushion — he never got inside, which makes the dead Shamrock the arc's warning rather than its opportunity, and is left entirely implicit. **Repo policy: no real families, names or allegations, ever** — structural pattern only, same rule as White Dish.

**The presence dilemma** (`_doWork`, `WORK_NIGHTS` in world.js) is what the expat stage is actually *about*, and the bar's real job: it puts a price on the night. **WORK / MIND** commits your evening to your own rail — takings ×`WORK_TAKINGS` 1.35 vs ×`AWAY_TAKINGS` 0.72 when Bert runs it, so your own rail is worth roughly double — but the soi is where สนุก, the encounters and the relationships live. Deliberately a *declared shift*, not a passive room check: standing about was always possible; declaring it is what makes it a choice. **What you get from a shift is what HAPPENED, not the fact of working** — one roll per night over `WORK_NIGHTS` (~42%, most nights nothing): two-week millionaires on the bell hourly, the one high-season night every regular turns up, a staff birthday that didn't go stupid, a football finish — offset by a drunk who turns, a girl who doesn't come in, a runner, and **the police**. That last one is where faction standing finally changes a night rather than a label: weighted by `G.syn.friction` and **gated off entirely at syndicate ≥ 2** — inside the arrangement it simply does not happen, which is what being inside IS. Ten consecutive shifts start the grind (`_WORK_GRIND`, −1 happy): a man who works every night in Pattaya has stopped living in Pattaya, and one night out resets it. Measured over six months: every night ฿481k/happy 5; every other night ฿173k/happy 43; one in four ฿822 and two months short; never worked, insolvent. **The books** (`G.bar`, constants in world.js, `_barSettle` from `_endNight`) — the player CANNOT buy a bar: pocket+bank tops out at ฿120,000 and an established Soi 6 beer bar is seven figures, so the sale is **seller-financed**, which is what Bert's line already implied (*"he'll take a regular over a company… he'll lose money on you"*). `BAR_DEPOSIT` ฿120k is deliberately your entire ceiling — `_barDeposit` fires at your own bar once the 51% is settled, and **opening night is gated on `barPaid`**; the ATM's ฿20k/day cap makes assembling it a few days' work on purpose. The old man then carries ฿1.68M at `BAR_MONTHLY` ฿25k every 30 days for six years, taken from the till, then your pocket, then arrears (he never chases — that's the point). Nightly: `BAR_TAKINGS`+swing, minus `BAR_COSTS` scaled by **`G.syn.friction`** (each refused procurement job is +8% supply, forever), ×`LOW_SEASON` 0.55 one month in four. A losing night comes out of your own pocket before it shows anywhere; only when pocket AND till are empty is the bar underwater. **This is what makes the procurement choice cost something**: measured over a year, inside clears every month with ~฿168k in the till, three jobs refused misses 10 months of 12, everything refused goes underwater. **BOOKS / TAKINGS** (`_doBooks`) is the readout. **Procurement, and the price of staying out of it** (`SYNDICATE_JOBS` in world.js — declarative; machinery in engine-systems.js) is the partnerTan endgame. Once you own the bar, work is given out through partners: cleaning, the screen, the till. Jobs arrive one a night at your own bar (`_synDue` → `_synAsk`, a `pendingChoice = "synjob"` modal wired the standard five ways), answering YES / NO / **ASK**. **The framing is load-bearing and the obvious version is wrong**: this is not corruption being discovered by a farang, it's how business is done here *and everywhere* — the only local difference is that nobody troubles to pretend otherwise. No character treats it as a scandal and the words *bribe*/*corruption* never appear (asserted by a test); Gavin's *"White Dish looks after its friends"* is the identical sentence in a British accent, and the envelopes sit at the good table the game already built (`orchid_recon`). The screen job carries the rule a farang most needs told: **you don't do the work yourself** — a man up a ladder with a drill is taking work off Thai people, and Tan is the one who says so. **Neutrality is always available and nothing is ever blocked.** Refusing costs no standing (`_align` is not called — nothing is *done* to you) and the work still happens, often cheaper on the invoice; what you lose is the frictionlessness, tracked as `G.syn.friction` and felt as ambient weather at your own bar (`_SYN_FRICTION`) — list prices, late deliveries, a form from an office that shuts at three, staff going quietly cagey. Survivable while the bar is busy; the intended pressure test is low season. **NOT SIMULATED**: the bar has no P&L, so all of that is prose — there is no modelled cost curve, and building one is the open piece.

**Quests** live in `QUESTS` (world.js): giver dialogue surfaces offers (`_questOffer` after `_doTalk` — it skips quests already in the "offered" state, so a multi-quest giver rotates through his jobs on re-talk rather than re-offering the first forever), ACCEPT/ABANDON/QUESTS verbs manage `G.quests` states, and `_questTick` (every turn) completes any active quest whose `doneFlag` is set, paying `reward`. `deps` gate offers on other quests being done; optional **`reqFlags`** gates on world-state flags the deps chain can't express (the Shamrock quest's `["hasDog"]`) — engine-action-set flags must join world.test's `settable` allowlist. The `doneFlag` design is deliberate — quests observe the world rather than owning it, so any mechanic becomes quest-completable with zero quest-specific code; keep it that way (patron dialogue `sets`, GIVE handlers, room visits, and game wins all complete quests today). Eleven quests ride it, including two dep-chained arcs: the sister-bar chain (sangsom → bee_number) and the **Glam family saga** (oldrocker → keys → quietmoney → family — Wimon/Diamond givers, the reveals living in the dialogue entries that set the flags). Grow the schema further only when a specific quest needs it, and build the future run-your-own-bar expat mechanic AS a dep-chained quest line (premises → license → staff → opening night), not as a new subsystem.

**Companions** (all in `G`, no NPC machinery): the **Jomtien beach cats** (`soi_cats` fixture item at jomtien_beach — Big One vets every hand before it reaches Little One; PET pays +1 สนุก once/day via `G.catDay`), and **the soi dog** — `G.dog` (`{since, name?}`, null until adopted; survives vacations, dies with `newGame()`). FEED DOG on a lit street adopts him (consumes noodles/moo_ping, else ฿20; a once-a-night street nudge via `G.dogNudgeDay` makes the path discoverable, suppressed during Act One). All dog prose is authored against "Sai Krok" and re-lettered at render time by `_dogN()` (function replacer, so `$`-names render literally) from `G.dog.name` (NAME/RENAME DOG, title-cased); `_isDogWord()` is the single answers-to test (defaults + current name) shared by FEED/PET/GIVE. He pays his keep in **protection** — darkStreak defusal in the turn tick, the tonic-shop/curse-ritual muscle stands down (`G.dog` checks in both LEAVE branches), and a rough-wake crash no longer empties your pockets — plus **social dividends**: in open-air `beer` bars he comes in under the rail and `_dogBarFavor` (once/bar/night via `G.soc.dogFavor`, ~50%, 21 scenes) bumps a random staffer's bond; rain reactions rotate (`_DOG_RAIN_BAR`/`_DOG_RAIN_STREET`) when he's in sight. **Transport** (both baht bus `_doPay` and motosai `_doMotosai`): a shared songthaew is an open truck bed, so he just rides along free (`_DOG_BUS`, no fare change); a motosai has one pillion seat already taken, so the piwin waves over a buddy's saleng for him — `DOG_MOTOSAI_FARE` ฿10 on top of the fare (flat, not late-hour-gouged), folded into the same `G.money` check as the ride itself (`total = price + dogFare`). Waived on the broke pity-ride (`G.money === 0` branch) — if you're riding on the piwin's mercy, so does he. The **Shamrock scene** (`_dogShamrock`, once ever, arriving on the Khao Talo strip with the dog) surfaces his history, grants the brass tag, completes Bert's reqFlags-gated quest, and carries the game's ONE fourth-wall line (the Soi Dog Foundation donation link) — keep it the only one.

**The phone** (`G.phone`): CONTACT in her bar at favor ≥2 swaps numbers; contacts text unprompted via `_maybeIncomingText` in `_tick` (invites reward showing up that night — checked in `_doGo`; messages can carry money, credited on CHECK MESSAGES); MESSAGE = once-per-night favor charm; SEND <amt> TO <name> is the banking app (favor bump scales with amount). Everything battery-gated. **The photo gallery** (`G.phone.photos` — an **array of `{id, cap?, turn}`**: a cap-less entry is a portrait you snapped, a captioned one is a selfie she texted; `_photoList()` coerces old/absent saves, `_hasPortrait`/`_addPhoto` are the accessors). PHOTO <someone present> (`_photoChar`) saves their portrait and, since you're clearly on first-name terms now, learns their name (`G.known[id]`) — a second way (besides being named in prose or TALKing) to reveal a titled stranger. Costs 1% battery, +1 สนุก first time, `_pickVary` pools (`_PHOTO_NEW`/`_PHOTO_DUP`); bare PHOTO keeps the old throwaway scene shots. The **go-go/Soi-6 house rule** (`_PHOTO_GOGO_NO`) refuses a stranger's camera on the girls — but your own **contact or bonded regular+** (`_bondTier ≥ 2`) sneaks one cheek-to-cheek (`_PHOTO_GOGO_YES`), so the collection stays achievable through the relationship system without breaking canon. GALLERY/PHOTOS/ALBUM (`_doGallery`) lists the collection (name + caption, else `_photoWhere` venue), the count also surfaces on the PHONE home screen. **Ladies text you selfies**: an NPC with a `selfies` caption pool (authored on a few story girls; hash-generated for ~40% of filler in `_buildHostess` from `_H_SELFIES`) occasionally texts one via `_maybeIncomingText` (`_maybePhotoText`) — filed to the gallery, captioned, on read (`_readMessages`), learning her name. **Wilai's pay-per-photo drip** (`paidPics` on her NPCS entry — the Ruby Kiss front-stool showwoman on Soi 6, an exhibitionist who performs on purpose and charges for the encore; reachable in the Soi 6 challenge mode. An ordered set, first frame a free teaser, the rest behind an escalating `ask`): when she first texts a contact she opens it (`_startPicDeal`) and arms `G.phone.picDeal`; **SEND ≥ the ask** advances it (`_advancePicDeal`, hooked in `_doSendMoney` before the generic reply — short pays get teased, not delivered) until the set runs out (`{done:true}`). PG-13 by design. **Distinct photo frames**: a `selfies`/`paidPics` entry may carry a **`pic` stem** (Wilai's 4 drip frames `wilai_pic1..4`, Ping/Lek's authored selfies `ping_sel*`/`lek_sel*`) — a real image in **`web/portraits/pics/<stem>.png`** (exquisite SDXL, generated by portrait_gen's `gen_pics.sh` from `characters.py` PHOTO_VARIANTS; the rear-view bikini frames are PG-13 swimwear with a nudity-guard negative). term.js's `_picFor(id, cap)` matches the caption printed on a gallery/message row to that entry and renders `portraits/pics/<stem>.png` instead of her bust, **falling back to the standard portrait** if the frame's missing (`_avatarSrc` onerror). Filler string-selfies carry no `pic`, so they correctly reuse the face portrait (a casual selfie IS a face shot). `web/portraits/pics/` is a subfolder, so `portraits.test.js` (top-level, non-recursive) never flags the frames as orphaned. Frontend: the gallery block **and** a texted-selfie line reuse term.js's `_addAvatars` (its prefix regex now matches `Gallery — ` and `📷 `), so the emoji swaps to the real portrait/frame inline — no new rendering path (E2E-covered in `tests/e2e/photo.spec.mjs` incl. the distinct-frame load, since the vm suite can't reach the DOM). Three-surfaced (parser PHOTO-target + `_completePool` + the wheel's per-character `photo` action + a HELP line).

**Quiz night**: Thursdays (`G.day % 7 === 4`; day 1 = Monday), nightTurn 20–39 (20:00–22:00), at three bars chosen by `_quizBars()` — a pure hash of (vacation, day), deliberately NOT `_rand()` so reading the schedule never advances the dice. Entering a quiz bar mid-window force-starts the quiz (`_quizHere` check in `_doGo`); questions from `QUIZ_POOL` (world.js); one per bar per night via `G.quizPlayed`; QUIT ejects to the street.

Bar mini-games (Connect 4 / Jackpot / pool / killer pool on league nights — `G.day % 3 === 0` at `room.pool` bars) run as a modal `G.game` state: while one is live, `doCommand` routes every input to `_gameInput` and QUIT concedes. Stakes are escrowed up front and paid back ×2 on a win (×3 on a Jackpot); broke players play "for sanuk" (stake 0). **Jackpot has a first-game tutorial**: until `flags.jpLearned`, the hostess (`opp`) walks you through it and *every* roll stops for a manual flip — even a forced single-option one that would normally auto-resolve in `_jpTurn` — so you learn the moves by making them (`_jpTeach` adds a coaching beat the first time you meet a two-way choice and a forced roll; `g.tutorial`/`g.taught` live on the game object). Finishing one full round sets `jpLearned` (survives vacations — `_newVacation` only clears `sabaiSabai`), and from then on forced rolls auto-play and only genuine two-way choices stop for you. Tabletop games are gated on `barType === "beer" | "soi6"`, pool on `room.pool`; `_playOptions()` is the room-aware list all offering surfaces use (bare PLAY fans out in the wheel and lists in prose), and during a live game `_gameVerbs()`/`_c4Choices()`/`_jpChoices()` drive autocomplete and the DROP/FLIP fan-outs.

- `web/js/thai.js` — Thai numbers (สิบเอ็ด/ยี่สิบ irregulars), Thai digits ๐–๙, signs, phrase matching. Pure functions.
- `web/js/news-data.js` — **auto-generated** (`scripts/fetch-news.mjs`, re-baked every 6 h by `.github/workflows/news.yml` from Google News RSS + Frankfurter/er-api FX + Open-Meteo weather; the bake runs the test suite before committing). Classic-script globals `NEWS_FEED`, `FX_RATES` (THB per USD/AUD/GBP/EUR), `WX_NOW` (real Pattaya temp/humidity/WMO code/rain odds), `FOOTY` (ESPN scoreboard — World Cup while it's on, else Premier League; SCORES verb, TV/paper segments, and the patron: every bar's regular gets a lifelong team via pure hash of bar id over the bake's teams, and a win is the ONE football→mechanics crossing — he buys the rail a round, guarded no-bake-no-dice like the rain), `LOTTO` (official GLO draw — LOTTERY verb, TV/paper), `GOLD` (XAU + Thai baht-weight at 96.5%, computed against the same bake's USD rate; paper business corner), and `BTC` (CoinGecko; the laser-eyed patron variant) so no runtime fetch is needed — they surface via WATCH TV / READ PAPER / the WEATHER verb, the **COLUMN**/OWL verb, and patron chatter (the FX moan invents a golden-age rate at current × 1.25; the weather moan is always the humidity), and the engine degrades to canned fallbacks when the globals are absent (which is how the vm tests run). **Never gate game logic on headlines or rates** — they change every bake; determinism holds only within a deploy. Weather has exactly ONE sanctioned mechanical crossing: a stormy `WX_NOW.code` (≥95 or 63/65/81/82) *enables* the rainy-season downpour system, but every roll goes through `G.rng` (checked before `_rand()` so a bake-less game consumes no dice — tests and `file://` are byte-identical to before). Downpours (`G.rain` = turns left, started by `_startRain`, 3–8 turns, 30-turn cooldown via `G.lastRain`): street moves are blocked unless the destination passes `_sheltered()` (bar/shop/outlet rooms — diving indoors is allowed), buses and motosai refuse, and the soi-dog dark-streak logic pauses (dogs shelter too). Below the storms, `_wxRainy()` (any rain-family code or rain odds ≥50%) enables **light-rain vignettes** — `_sayDrizzle` in `_tick` (15-turn cooldown via `G.lastDrizzle`) plus a rainy-season patron line — which are atmosphere ONLY: they print, pick their variant by turn parity, and touch no mechanics. Don't add a second weather→mechanics path without the same no-bake-no-dice guard. Separately, the **Nite Owl column** (`_doColumn`; verbs COLUMN/OWL) is NOT auto-generated — it's hand-authored pools (`_OWL_LEADS`/`_OWL_LETTERS`/`_OWL_JOKES`/`_OWL_LISTINGS` in engine-systems.js) that dispense the **universe's own canon** as a fictionalised-Trink columnist's copy: a lead opinion, a bar listing, a reader letter + the OWL's reply, a joke, and the "BUT, I DON'T GIVE A HOOT!" signoff, assembled day+vacation-stable via `_owlPick` (like `_quizBars`). Its in-fiction author is patron **Mort** (Queen Vic); **grow it by adding pool items as canon grows** (it's the natural home for scene-wisdom mined from trip reports / columns). Keep pool prose inside the vendored vocab (romanise Thai concepts — the term.js Thai-coverage test scans it).
- `web/js/world.js` — all rooms, items, NPCs, dialogue, bus/motosai lines. **Pure declarative data**, the source of truth. Dialogue entries are `{req, notFlags, topic, th, rom, text, short, sets, gives}`; first matching entry wins, `_pickDialogue` falls back to the topicless entry on unknown topics — and before it does, `_doTalkBody` retries the ask through the `_CONVO_TOPIC_RULES` synonym map (literal key first, so a node keyed on a word that's also a synonym — Mercedes's `german` — keeps its literal match). So one alias row serves typed ASK, the wheel, and the conversation layer alike: key sibling NPCs on ONE canonical topic (`sponsor`, not `boyfriend`) and add the phrasings to the rules table. `_deliver` tracks which entries an NPC has already spoken (`G.talked[npcId]` = seen indices, serialized) and on a repeat swaps `text`→`short` and drops the Thai greeting, so re-talking gives the gist not the full spiel. **Every repeat is terse**: with no `short`, a pure-flavour entry (no `gives`/`sets`) gets a generic brush-off (`_askAgain`, the NPCs' fond soi voice; `_patronAgain` for rail regulars), but a quest/clue entry that carries a re-readable payload (`gives`/`sets`) still repeats in full so a forgotten instruction can be re-read. Authoring a `short` on those is the way to make them terse too. `_patronTalk` mirrors all of this against `G.patronTalk.talked` (reset daily). **The ask loop, and your side of it**: a node's `asks: {key, q}` puts a question to the PLAYER (`_convoAsk`, once per key per partner) and arms `G.convoQ`; the next plain line is captured by `_convoAnswer` into `G.player.said[key]` (+trust, +rep), and telling it two ways is caught — by her (`heard[key]`, −2 rep) or by the grapevine (`said[key]`, −1). **`ASK_REPLIES`** (world.js) gives each key canned replies in the player's own voice, tagged `pers:`(personality) or `origin:` (untagged = anybody); `_askReplies(key)` returns the identity-matched ones first, capped at 3, and they surface as **chip-bar answers + a numbered prose list** while a question is pending (free text is still the primary path; a bare digit picks one, and an out-of-range digit re-prompts rather than being stored as your answer). Tapping your own voice keeps your story straight across the soi — the consistency tension is the feature. A key quoted back through a `%token%` (today `%home%`) is **title-cased on replay**, so those answers must be a place or two words, never a sentence. **Filler hostesses**: the story-bearing girls are hand-authored NPCS entries, but every bar is also stocked with rank-and-file hostesses from the `_FILLER_HOSTESSES` `[name, th, room]` table, each expanded by `_buildHostess` — flavour (Isan hometown, family-support line, plan, look, greeting/family/home/plan/wallet dialogue) is **hash-picked from the id** (`_hh`), so the store stays tiny, a bar reads populated, and each girl is stable (same id → same backstory). Canon: most are Isan girls sending money home, speaking **Tinglish** with Google Translate on the phone the moment talk gets past small — keep that voice, and keep authored/plot dialogue OUT of the generator. **Filler mamas & cashiers** work the same way (`_FILLER_MAMAS`/`_FILLER_CASHIERS` tables → `_buildMama`/`_buildCashier`): every hostess venue gets exactly one mamasan (👑) and one cashier (🧾) plus ≥2 hostesses, so the role mechanics (mamasan rescue/blessing/contact-caps, cashier till caps) have someone to hang on at every bar. **A chain shares one mamasan** — Candy's `bars` list covers both Candy Bars, so they're absent from `_FILLER_MAMAS`; cashiers are still per-bar. The **English register steps up by role**: hostesses talk Tinglish, cashiers are businesslike and mostly fluent, the mamasan is the most fluent — each still drops a Thai particle now and then. The Queen Vic pub gets none of the three. Adding any NPC/patron needs a matching portrait — add a spec to `scripts/gen-portraits.py` CHARS (the filler cast uses procedurally-varied `lady(...)` specs) and re-run it, or the portrait coverage test fails.
- `web/js/games.js` — bar mini-game logic (Connect 4 + AI, Jackpot shut-the-box dice, abstract 8-ball pool). Pure functions, no `G`, no output; every random decision takes an injected `rnd()`. Loaded between world.js and engine-core.js. The C4 hostess is a **negamax with alpha-beta** (`c4Ai(board, rnd, depth = 8)` — `rnd` only tie-breaks equal roots, so play is seed-deterministic; ~140 ms worst move at 8; depth 7 is WORSE than 6 — horizon parity — so keep even depths). **Skill ladder** via `_c4Depth(id)` (world.js): mamasans 8 (the shark — an experienced-player proxy scores 0 wins, mostly draws), floor girls 6 (beatable by a player who plans deeper), and new girls 2 (`c4: 2` on the NPC — Nong's explicit, and `_buildHostess` tags any filler whose hash-picked desc starts "New enough"/"Baby-faced", so the tier is readable in her description). `_gameHostess()` returns `{id, name}` (canon girl first, else any staff) and `_startC4` stores `oppId`/`depth` on `G.game` — the intro line telegraphs the tier; pre-tier saves default to 8. **Distractions**: a parked saleng (`_salengHere()`) or a downpour (`G.rain > 0`) drops the girl one rung (`_c4TierDown`: 8→6→2→1) while it lasts — **never the mamasan** — checked per MOVE (carts leave and rain stops mid-game), with cause-specific prose on each transition (`_C4_DISTRACT`/`_C4_REFOCUS`/`_C4_IMMUNE`, keyed off `g.distKey`, which rides the save so restores don't re-announce).
- `web/js/engine-core.js` + `engine-encounters.js` + `engine-play.js` + `engine-systems.js` + `engine-parser.js` — the engine, split into **five classic scripts sharing globals**, loaded in that order after world.js/games.js (index.html and every vm-test load list). `engine-core` declares `G` and the `print`/`speak` hooks and must load first; nothing runs at load beyond const initializers, so functions may live in any part. Each file's header says what it holds; treat them as one engine. Together they own state (`G`), parser, action handlers, systems (battery/darkness/soi dog, money, score, endings). DOM-free at load; all output goes through the `print`/`speak`/`sfx` callbacks injected via `engineInit` (`_engineSfx(name)` is the one-shot sound hook — `_doBell` fires `"bell"`; no-op headless). Random street encounters: scene data in `ENCOUNTERS` (world.js), resolvers in `_ENC` (engine-encounters.js); the RNG is a Lehmer LCG whose state lives in `G.rng`, so rolls serialize with the save and UNDO can't reroll them — tests fire encounters deterministically via `_startEnc(id)`. Interactive encounters set `G.pendingEnc`; the next command is routed to the resolver as the player's snap reaction. **The ซาเล้ง (saleng) is deliberately NOT an encounter** — it's a *room fixture for the girls*, all of it in `_salengTick` (engine-encounters, called once per `_tick`). A cart spawns inside a saleng-eligible bar and parks for a random 6–12 turns (`salengCart`/`salengRoom`/`salengUntil` on G — **never** `pendingEnc`, so it never gates or eats a command). The hostesses/mamas swarm it (~20% per tick, `_salengVignette`; lingerie gets its own customer-facing crowd scene); the player may ignore it, buy from it repeatedly (`_doBuy` routes cart-only items to `_salengBuy` *after* the bar goods, so shared words like "bra"/"drink" still hit the bar), or come back before it moves on. It leaves only when `salengUntil` passes (a farewell line if you're in the room). Per-type copy (pitch/notice/hint/here-line/items) lives in the `_SALENG_CARTS` table; `_salengMatchItem` (regex, keyed on `salengCart`) is the shared price/nutrition matcher. First cart of each type (`salengSeen[type]`) gets the full inviting pitch; later ones a terse notice. A parked cart re-announces on restore through `_describeRoom` (the `_salengHere()` line), like rain/darkness — not a modal redraw. Every *encounter* prompt that leaves `pendingEnc` set must go through `_encPrompt(...[text, cls])` (not bare `_say`), which stashes the prompt lines in `G.encPrompt` so a restore/UNDO can redraw them — `_renderEncounter()` replays the stash. **Restore redraw is centralised in `_renderResume()`** (engine-parser.js): `doCommand` routes input through a chain of *modal input-gating states* — `pendingChoice` (airline / checkout), `G.game`, `pendingEnc`, `pendingFare` — each of which silently swallows commands until answered, so each needs its prompt redrawn on continue/UNDO or the load is blind (the bug class that hit c4, jackpot, and saleng). `_renderResume` is the single dispatcher, mirroring doCommand's gate *priority order*; main.js calls it (not the individual `_renderGame`/`_renderEncounter`) after `_describeRoom`. It also re-surfaces the unread-text count (the "phone buzzed" nudge is a one-shot at arrival, lost on reload). Ambient scene state that a reload must re-establish lives in `_describeRoom` instead: a **downpour** (`G.rain > 0`) re-announces itself there every describe — like darkness does — because rain gates movement, so a silent reload would paint a dry, walkable street and the block that follows would read as a bug. Add a new modal gate to **both** doCommand and `_renderResume`, and route its prompt through a shared helper (`_vacationEndPrompt`/`_checkoutPrompt`/`_farePrompt`/`_encPrompt`/`_renderGame`) so the live prompt, the invalid-answer reprompt, and the resume redraw stay identical. Long scripted tests that walk eligible streets should first mark all of `G.encDone`. **The Zork ledger**: the parser answers the classic-Infocom verb set — DRINK (routes into `_doBuy`), DIAGNOSE (reads the survival stats), AGAIN/G (repeats `_lastCmd` — a module-local on purpose: parser convenience, not game state, so it neither serializes nor concerns a 2D frontend), SMELL/LISTEN (per-`region` tables `_SMELLS`/`_SOUNDS` with a bar override), KILL/HIT/etc. (canon refusal — the piwins are why violence never becomes mechanics), location-aware SWIM/DANCE/SING, and the XYZZY/PLUGH/PRAY/HELLO SAILOR easter eggs. All flavor-only beyond the normal tick. House rule: "I didn't understand that" is a last resort — give a plausible verb a voiced refusal rather than letting it fall through. **QoL/mechanical verbs**: TIME (clock + tonight's barfine/quiz pricing), WAIT <n>/WAIT UNTIL <hour|MIDNIGHT> (fast-forward loop in `_doWait`; stops early on encounters, incoming texts, or night end — each skipped turn still pays full `_tick` costs), TIP <lady> <amt> (฿100+ bumps `soc.drinks` favor, ฿300+ double; small notes are flavor; piwins refuse pre-ride), HAGGLE (peddler-encounter reaction; sets `flags.peddlerDeal` once, ~⅓ off, re-arms `pendingEnc`), WAVE (hails the bus via `_doRideBus`), TRAVEL/GOTO <bar|hotel> (fast travel to any visited bar — `G.visited`, marked in `_describeRoom` — plus your own hotel, which needs no discovering; the room you stand in is never offered; BFS hop count over the exits graph paid in full `_tick`s so it saves keystrokes not time; GO/ENTER with a non-adjacent place name fall through to it, and arrival runs the shared `_arriveAt` — door bans, quiz capture, invitations, encounters — same as walking; free by design for now, revisit pricing later), MAP (`_MAP` ASCII bar-mat map — update it when the street grid changes), SAFE/KEYPAD/CODE/PIN `<digits>` (Madam Oy's safe — plus a **bare number** while you stand in `oy_office`, since every modal gate returns before the verb switch; `ENTER <digits>` still works and is the tap-hint on the item. Three routes because the climax of Act One must not answer a keypad with "I didn't understand that"), WITHDRAW/ATM (mirrors the lobby-ATM hook; stage-aware), REPORT/FILE (`_doReport`; at `police_station` claws back a tonic-shop fleece from `G.tonicOwed`, elsewhere points you to the station — surfaced in autocomplete only at the station or while owed, and via CAPS tap-hints), plus PHOTO (1% battery), CALL (teaches MESSAGE), SHOWER, CHEERS, SEARCH→examine. **Known names**: `_say` feeds `_learnNames`, which marks a character in `G.known` the first time their name prints (word-boundary, case-sensitive match on the capitalised last word of `name` — "Madam Oy" → Oy; lowercase names like "security" never register); `_topicKnown(topic)` gates every surface that *offers* ask-topics — `engineComplete`'s `ask <npc> about` candidates and term.js's flyout wheel — so nobody's name is suggested before the transcript has mentioned it. Typed ASK is deliberately not gated. **Identity labels** (the reveal was DROPPED): everyone is **named on sight** — `_npcLabel(id)`/`_patronLabel(id)` just return the name (the titles-until-met gating was removed per playtest: gating a few characters while ~230 staff were named on sight read as inconsistent; the code comment at `_npcLabel` in engine-core.js documents how to restore it). The optional **`title`** fields stay in the data (every PATRON via the `_PATRON_TITLES` batch; Gavin the one titled NPC) but only as *look-resolution*: `_findNpc`/`_findPatron` still resolve a description back to its id (`talk to the owlish old-timer`, `photo the golf-shirted man`) — they never replace a name in the UI. `_say` also journals every Thai run it prints into **`G.thaiSeen`** (deduped, capped 60, serialized) — the Soi Sanuk trainer, served from the same origin, reads it out of `lbb_save` and offers "words from the bus" practice; keep the collection in `_say` (engine stays storage-free — the save is the wire). **Save compatibility is automatic**: `deserializeGame` merges the parsed save over a fresh `newGame()` skeleton (one level deep — plain-object fields merge key-by-key, so `soc`/`phone`/`itemLoc` gain sub-keys added since the save; everything else the save wins wholesale). **A new `G` field needs no backfill** — just add it to `newGame()`. Only *semantic* migrations (repairs that depend on the save's own contents, e.g. inferring `stage` on pre-sandbox saves) live in `deserializeGame` by hand. `_barName(roomId)` (world.js, loads first) is the one way to render a room as a venue name (`bar || name`, undefined for unknown ids — callers pick the fallback).
- `web/js/term.js` / `main.js` — the terminal frontend: scrollback, history, verb chips, autosave (`lbb_save`), continue-prompt (which calls the engine's `_renderResume()` after `_describeRoom` to redraw whatever modal state was gating input — game/encounter/checkout/fare/airline — so none loads invisible), one-level UNDO, music unlock on first gesture, a `#term-send` button so wheel-prefilled commands submit without a keyboard, and the **floating action buttons** in the top-right `#fab-stack` (a flex column so either can appear alone or stacked): `#bell-fab` (shown in bars/go-gos via `_inBar`, tap submits `ring bell`) and `#msg-fab` (shown while `_unreadCount() > 0`, tap submits `check messages` which prints the texts and marks them read, so the glyph self-hides). Both are refreshed together by `_updateFabs()` after every `submit` and at boot — add a new FAB there and to the stack. All persistence lives in `main.js`; the engine is storage-free. **Decoration + the flyout wheel** live here too (presentation, never engine): `decorate()` wraps actionable words in `<b class="kw" data-k data-v>` (npc/patron/bar/item/exit/cmd, plus `thai` — Thai runs tokenised via the vendored tokeniser against WORDS + NPC `th` names so entity names stay whole); an **item** name after a third-person possessive (`her phone`, `his wallet`, `Candy's phone`) is left plain — it's somebody else's, not your tappable inventory — while `your`/`the phone` still tap through; for the residual cases the heuristic can't infer, authored content can wrap a span in **`{{…}}`** to suppress *all* tap-decoration inside (`grabs another {{phone}}`, `{{a proper noun that isn't gossipable}}`) — decorate() prints the inner text verbatim and decorates nothing in it (it swaps each span to an inert placeholder, runs every pass, then restores). The braces are render-only markup the engine never emits or acts on; `stripMarkup(text)` (engine-core.js) removes them for any consumer that prints `_say` text **without** the decorate() pass (a plain log, a future served/2D frontend). Writers must add `{{…}}` by hand where needed — a forgotten one just falls back to the old over-eager tap, never an error; tap = `_kwActions(k, v, false)` quick menu (single go/fn action fires instantly — exits walk, plain Thai opens the word card), long-press (500 ms, drag-cancelled) or right-click = the full list including an NPC's live ask-topics. Ask-topics that are somebody's name are hidden until that character is known — the wheel and the input autocomplete both filter through the engine's `_topicKnown` (see the engine bullet).
